name: Skikda

queries.query: Skikda Algeria official cadastral map parcel viewer cadastre conservation foncière
queries.result: Discovery identified the ASGA InfoGéoAlgérie national cartographic viewer, the Ministry of Finance cadastral/land geoportal, and a Skikda wilaya directory naming the local cadastral and land-conservation directorates. No anonymous public parcel feature service was verified.

queries.result: Arabic/French discovery found Skikda local cadastral and conservation-foncière directory evidence, national cadastral procedure material, and an official Ministry of Tourism reference to land-survey plans for Skikda; no public parcel geometry/API response was obtained.

researchNote: Local directory evidence names Direction du cadastre de Skikda and Direction de la conservation foncière, but the public directory is not itself a verified parcel map/API. Official national viewer and geoportal routes were tested anonymously and did not yield inspectable configuration or parcel data. No sample is retained.
